# 2Wise

> 2Wise is a JAMB UTME preparation app for Nigerian candidates (Android, web). It runs full CBT mock exams scored out of 400, finds each student's weak topics and drills them, explains every answer, and works offline. 7-day free trial, then ₦3,000 a year.

## Product

- [Home](https://2wise.com.ng/): what 2Wise does and pricing
- [Download the Android app](https://2wise.com.ng/download/)
- [Web app](https://app.2wise.com.ng)

## JAMB guides

- [JAMB past questions and answers by subject](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/): Free JAMB practice questions with answers and explanations for 8 subjects.
- [JAMB Use of English past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/english/): Free JAMB Use of English practice questions with answers and full explanations, plus the topics that come up every year, how the 60-question paper works and how to stop losing easy marks.
- [JAMB Mathematics past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/mathematics/): Free JAMB Mathematics practice questions with step-by-step solutions, the topics that come up every year, and how to work fast enough to finish 40 questions with time to spare.
- [JAMB Physics past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/physics/): Free JAMB Physics practice questions with full working, the topics that come up every year from motion to half-life, and how to choose the right formula fast.
- [JAMB Chemistry past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/chemistry/): Free JAMB Chemistry practice questions with answers and explanations, the topics that repeat every year from the mole concept to organic chemistry, and the slips that cost candidates marks.
- [JAMB Biology past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/biology/): Free JAMB Biology practice questions with answers and explanations, the topics that come up every year from cells to genetics, and how to stop losing marks on terms you almost know.
- [JAMB Economics past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/economics/): Free JAMB Economics practice questions with answers and explanations, covering demand and supply, elasticity, costs, market structures, national income and money, and the topics that repeat every year.
- [JAMB Government past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/government/): Free JAMB Government practice questions with answers and explanations, covering separation of powers, the rule of law, federalism, Nigeria's constitutional history, elections and international organisations.
- [JAMB Literature-in-English past questions](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-past-questions/literature/): Free JAMB Literature-in-English practice questions with answers and explanations, covering literary devices, poetry, prose and drama terms, and how to prepare the prescribed texts.
- [Free JAMB CBT practice for 2027](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-cbt-practice/): Practise JAMB CBT exactly like the real UTME: 180 questions, 2 hours, scored out of 400. Free on Android, Windows, Linux and web, and it works offline.
- [JAMB aggregate score calculator](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-aggregate-calculator/): Calculate your admission aggregate in seconds: UTME ÷ 8 plus Post-UTME ÷ 2, or UTME ÷ 8 plus O'level points. Free, with the working shown.
- [How to check your JAMB result by SMS and online](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/how-to-check-jamb-result/): Text UTMERESULT to 55019 or 66019 from the SIM you registered with. Here's every way to check your JAMB result, what each reply means, and how to print the slip.
- [WAEC 2027: exam date, registration and the new hybrid CBT mode](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/waec-2027/): WASSCE 2027 for school candidates is proposed for 11 May – 18 June 2027 and will run in hybrid CBT mode. Dates, registration, fees and a JAMB-plus-WAEC study plan.
- [JAMB syllabus 2027: the topics to study in every major subject](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-syllabus-2027/): The JAMB syllabus is the official list of everything the UTME can test. Here's what's in the 2027 JAMB syllabus for Use of English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Economics, Government and Literature, and how to turn it into a study plan.
- [JAMB past questions and answers: how to use them to actually score high](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-past-questions-and-answers/): Does JAMB repeat past questions? Where can you get JAMB past questions for free, and how many should you do a day? Here's the method that turns past questions into a higher UTME score, subject by subject.
- [JAMB 2027 date: the UTME moves to March 15–25, 2027](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-2027-date/): The 2027 UTME has been proposed for 15–25 March 2027, about a month earlier than usual. Here's the full 2027 exam timetable, what it means for JAMB registration and the mock, the new rules for 2027, and a 16-week plan to get ready.
- [How to score 300 in JAMB 2027](https://2wise.com.ng/how-to-score-300/): A realistic plan to reach 300 in the UTME: what 300 actually means per subject, how to find the marks you're losing, and a daily routine that works.
- [JAMB subject combinations for popular courses](https://2wise.com.ng/jamb-subjects/): The usual UTME subject combinations for Medicine, Nursing, Engineering, Law, Accounting, Computer Science and more, and how to confirm yours before you register.
- [JAMB 2027: everything you need to know](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-2027-guide/): What to expect from the 2027 UTME: the exam format, how to get your profile code, typical registration timing and fees (based on 2026), the set novel, and how to start preparing now.
- [How is JAMB scored?](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/how-jamb-is-scored/): JAMB scores each of your four subjects out of 100 for a total of 400. Here's what each question is worth, whether wrong answers cost you, and what that means for your strategy.
- [JAMB cut-off marks: what you really need](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-cut-off-marks/): JAMB's minimum cut-off for 2026 was 150 for universities and 100 for polytechnics. Here's why that isn't your real target, and how to work out the score you actually need.
- [The Lekki Headmaster: how to study it for JAMB](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/the-lekki-headmaster-jamb-guide/): The Lekki Headmaster by Kabir Alabi Garba is the JAMB Use of English set novel. Here's what it's about, the kinds of questions JAMB asks, and a two-week plan to read it properly.
- [JAMB synonyms and antonyms: stop losing easy marks](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-synonyms-antonyms/): "Nearest in meaning" and "opposite in meaning" questions are some of the most learnable marks in JAMB English. Here's how they work, the traps JAMB sets, and a 5-words-a-day method that sticks.
- [Writing JAMB again? How to score much higher this time](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/retake-jamb-score-higher/): A low JAMB score usually comes from a few fixable causes, not a lack of brains. Here's how to find out what went wrong and build a plan that changes the result.
- [JAMB CBT exam-day tips: timing, strategy and what to bring](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/jamb-cbt-exam-day-tips/): How to pace 180 questions in 2 hours, a two-pass strategy that protects your score, and the practical things to sort out before you get to the CBT centre.
- [Why students who read for six hours can score lower than students who study for two](https://2wise.com.ng/blog/why-students-who-read-for-six-hours-can-score-lower-than-students-who-study-for-two/): Why students who read for six hours can score lower than students who study for two
